findings.title: [P0] Restore the `RequestOptions` export deleted from types.ts
findings.body: The diff removes `export interface RequestOptions { timeoutMs: number }` (old `src/types.ts:1`), but `src/client.ts:1` imports `{ RequestOptions, ClientOptions }` from `./types` and `request()` at line 3 still annotates its parameter as `RequestOptions` and reads `options.timeoutMs`. TypeScript reports TS2305 (`Module '"./types"' has no exported member 'RequestOptions'`) for the named import, and no compiler option suppresses an unresolved named import — so any type-check/build that includes `client.ts` fails unconditionally, independent of inputs or configuration. This also contradicts the PR's stated intent of "preserving existing contracts": `RequestOptions` was a public type contract consumed in-repo. Restore the interface (or keep it exported) so `client.ts` resolves; two review lanes independently confirmed the breakage against both files.

findings.title: [P3] Remove the unused `ClientOptions` import in client.ts
findings.body: The changed import line adds `ClientOptions`, but the 4-line `client.ts` never references it — `ClientOptions` is only used by `normalizeClientOptions` in `types.ts`. It is dead code, and builds enabling `noUnusedLocals` would report TS6133 (no tsconfig exists in the repo, so this is configuration-dependent only). Drop the identifier or use it as intended.
